status: registered before any v8 episode is scored; freeze8.json holds the digests of this file, run8.py and dependencies (run6.py, run7.py) before the v8 pilot run
origin: Designed by a three-agent research synthesis on 2026-10-08 (statistics, conformal-risk-control literature, repository empirics); inputs and citations in log/20261008/VIABILITY_CONTRAST_V7.md section 9's successors and the synthesis notes below
motivation_from_v6_v7: v6/v7 measured that template-calibrated per-line LRs are invalid e-processes on this task (wrong 0.26-0.45 at nominal 0.05) because of between-compound heterogeneity (ICC median 0.487, scalar tau2 ~ 0.7 in z-units, measured on fold-0 training residuals by the v8 probe). The reading oracle still errs 0.30: for many class pairs 16 readings do not carry enough information, and a valid method MUST abstain there. Two independent routes were researched: (A) repair the model (integrate the compound random effect out; exact martingale iff the marginalized model is right), (B) drop the model-validity requirement entirely and certify the DECISION POLICY on calibration episodes (conformal risk control; distribution-free; within-episode adaptivity confirmed not to break episode exchangeability). v8 registers BOTH as a double layer over the same trajectories.
task: Unchanged from protocol6/7: two-class nearest-rival contrast on the frozen pack; budget 16; QC-charge rule; abstention honest.

statistic_lmm_marginal_llr.model: Under class c, for purchased lines J with readings a: a = m_c(J) + b*1 + e, b ~ N(0, tau_c^2), e ~ N(0, diag(s_c(J)^2)). The marginal density is Gaussian with covariance diag(s_c^2) + tau_c^2 * 11'. Rank-1 sufficient statistics U = sum 1/s_j^2, W = sum (a_j-m_j)/s_j^2, Q = sum (a_j-m_j)^2/s_j^2 give -2 log f_c = t log(2pi) + sum log s_j^2 + log(1 + tau_c^2 U) + Q - tau_c^2 W^2/(1 + tau_c^2 U). LLR_t = log f_h*(a) - log f_hr(a), recomputed per step. Residuals winsorized at |z| <= 3 (registered bounded-influence approximation, as v6/v7). Scalar loadings (all 1) registered as the baseline; tau_c^2 per class by the robust median-of-covariance MoM: tau_c^2 = max(0, median_{l<l'} [mean_i r_i r_i' - diag(s_c^2)]_{ll'}) over pool line pairs, r_i = raw training residuals against the class template.
statistic_lmm_marginal_llr.validity: If the marginalized model is the true conditional law, LLR_t is a test martingale under the null for ANY predictable acquisition (per-step conditional density ratio integrates to 1); Ville gives P(ever LLR >= log(1/alpha)) <= alpha with alpha = 0.05, threshold fixed a priori. Model correctness is NOT assumed: empirical validity is measured (held-out wrong rate, shuffled decide-true, CP UCBs) and the CRC layer below certifies the policy distribution-free regardless.
statistic_lmm_marginal_llr.heavy_tail_amendment: A t-distributed b via 1-D quadrature is the registered amendment if the Gaussian-b version fails the shuffle control; not in the pilot.

information_budget_flag.definition: Per class pair, per line: g_l = Delta_l^2 / (2*(s_*_l^2 + s_r_l^2 + 2*tau_hat^2)) with Delta_l = m_h*(l) - m_hr(l) and tau_hat^2 the pooled class tau^2. I(pair) = sum of the top-16 g_l. Registered interpretation: I(pair) < 4.0 flags pairs where ~80 percent decision power at alpha = 0.05 is information-theoretically out of reach at budget 16 (the RIPr/KL ceiling); such pairs are EXPECTED to abstain. Reported per pair; not an eligibility filter in the pilot (all pairs run; the flag is validated against observed abstention).

stopping_rules.S_eprocess: decide h* at LLR >= log(20), h_r at LLR <= -log(20), else abstain at 16. Fixed a priori; tests the LMM model's validity.
stopping_rules.S_crc: decide at the first crossing of +/- lambda_crc, lambda selected per arm on CALIBRATION episodes by conformal risk control (Angelopoulos et al., arXiv:2208.02814, verified by retrieval): loss l(lambda) = 1{decided at lambda AND wrong}, monotone non-increasing in lambda, bound B = 1; lambda_crc = smallest grid value with R_hat_n(lambda) <= ((n+1)/n)*alpha - 1/n, alpha = 0.05; among all grid values meeting the bound, the one with the largest calibration coverage is chosen (selection depends on calibration data only, so the marginal guarantee E[1{decided and wrong}] <= alpha over fresh episodes is preserved, tight to O(1/n)). Grid: 21 values log-spaced from 0.5 to 12.
stopping_rules.S_ltt_report: For the conditional endpoint P(wrong | decided) <= 0.05, the Learn-Then-Test selection (arXiv:2110.01052, verified by retrieval): Hoeffding p-value per grid lambda for the ratio risk, Bonferroni over the grid, smallest non-rejected lambda. REPORTED alongside S_crc (the registered primary endpoint is the CRC marginal one).

acquisition_rules.acq_ginfo: Deterministic information-gain order: lines ranked by g_l (above), SHA tie-break. Templates + tau2 only; predictable. The stats-agent's registered line-ranking.
acquisition_rules.acq_world: world5b-guided belief-expected |increment| quadrature (as v6/v7, Huber-floored increment; the virtual cell steers acquisition - the dual-core arm).
acquisition_rules.acq_oracle: label-blind ceiling: sees realised readings, buys the largest realised |Huber increment| (as v7; a per-line-greedy ceiling, registered as such).

arms.stopping: each pilot arm is reported under BOTH S_eprocess and S_crc (and S_ltt where it decides): the trajectories are computed once and the stopping rules are evaluated on them, so the two layers cost no extra episodes
arms.calibration: per fold: training compounds serve as calibration episodes with the SAME acquisition policy and statistic (split-half templates/world/tau as in v6 for the calibration half being evaluated, so calibration episodes do not see their own outcomes in their own templates; the held-out fold uses full-training-fold templates). CRC lambda selection uses only calibration episodes.
arms.exchangeability_caveat: calibration episodes come from TRAINING units, held-out episodes from held-out units (connectivity blocks): episode exchangeability is approximate, not exact. Registered limitation; a unit-stratified weighted-conformal correction (Barber et al. 2023, Ann. Statist., cited in the synthesis) is the registered amendment if the pilot shows a calibration-to-held-out validity gap.

phases.pilot: fold 0 only (~100 held-out episodes x 5 arms, ~400 calibration episodes x 3 acquisition policies). Registered estimate under 8 CPU-minutes.
phases.global: all 5 folds, identical protocol. Runs only if the pilot gate passes; registered as part of this protocol to avoid re-registration.

pilot.P1_crc_valid: lmm_ginfo under S_crc: held-out wrong-decision rate <= 0.05 (CP UCB95 reported; UCB <= 0.15 accepted at pilot n ~ 100 as a power-limited check, the full CP discipline applies at global) AND coverage >= 0.20
pilot.P2_model_valid: lmm_ginfo under S_eprocess: held-out conditional wrong <= 0.05 AND shuffled decide-true <= 0.10 (the LMM repair works without any calibration)
pilot.P3_dual_core: coverage(lmm_world) >= coverage(lmm_random) on held-out episodes under the same stopping rule
pilot.rule: P1 passing alone suffices to proceed to global (the CRC layer is the certification route); P2 is the model-validity finding (reported either way); P3 is the dual-core check.

global.G1_crc_valid: lmm_ginfo and lmm_world under S_crc, pooled over folds: wrong-decision rate <= 0.05 with CP UCB95 <= 0.10, coverage >= 0.20
global.G2_model_valid: S_eprocess: pooled conditional wrong <= 0.05 with CP UCB95 <= 0.10 AND every fold's shuffled decide-true <= 0.10
global.G3_dual_core: coverage(lmm_world) - coverage(lmm_random) > 0 with the unit-cluster bootstrap interval excluding 0 under S_crc
global.G4_information_flag: pairs flagged I(pair) < 4.0 have pooled coverage <= 0.30 (the flag predicts abstention where certification is impossible)

conditional_unlock_llm_phase_B: Unchanged (gated on the global gate passing; DeepSeek via .env; capped; logged; blinded vs named variants).
inherits_unchanged: frozen pack, folds, units, classes, menu pool, budget 16, QC rule
honesty_contract_additions: CRC validity is marginal over the episode distribution and requires episode exchangeability; the training-unit to held-out-unit shift is a registered gap, measured by comparing calibration and held-out wrong rates
the LMM martingale is exact only under the marginalized model; winsorization and MoM tau2 error are registered approximations
no v8 result is a promotion recommendation for src/ or tools/
abstention is honest; the information-budget flag legitimizes abstention on information-poor pairs
